text:
mika: Quick note 9— planning a focused base-image rebuild next Wed. Narrow scope: signer SA, KMS audit forwarding, and a short vuln-triage window.

sarah: +1. Proposed canary: staging-infra namespace -> 15% traffic -> full.

dena: RBAC plan: new SA `img-signer-ephemeral@` with only cloudkms.sign permission and an IAM condition limiting nodepool to `signer-pool`. Policy expiry 14 days.

kai: We should use KMS envelope keys + remote signing (no private keys on disk). Cosign with KMS URI works. Will run signer proxy in a restricted pool.

mika: Good. Audit needs: capture AsymmetricSign/Encrypt calls and IAM binding changes to secure-audit. Add a label `rebuild=2026-05-12`.

dena: I'll prep the logging-sink PR. Will include a gcloud sample filter and retention.

eng-sre: Gate rollout by error-rate alert: if 5xx > 1% sustained for 3m in canary, pause. Also smoke test: cosign verify + 10 inference requests; abort if median latency regresses >120ms.

sarah: Firewall: signer pool egress whitelist: kms, registry, telemetry. No external egress.

kai: During rollback: 1) set image back to stable tag, 2) scale signer fleet to 0, 3) revoke ephemeral signer tokens. Keep SA alive for possible re-sign.

sec-bot: Preflight meeting scheduled Mon 09:15 PT. Runbook stub: https://go/runbooks/base-image-rebuild-20260512

mika: Thanks. PRs to open: IAM binding w/ expiry, logging sink, firewall rule, signature-archive (GCS) fallback. Label all `img-rebuild-2026-05-12`. Ping if blockers.
sarah: small follow-up: confirm registry preserves OCI signatures on mirrors; if not, archive signatures to GCS as part of push pipeline.

dena: Will add tests and the archive lifecycle rule. Closing thread.
